text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOf(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PrussianStateParliament ::: the Prussian State Parliament.
NaziReichstag ::: the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
German(heinrich) ∧ Politician(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
MemberOf(heinrich, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ MemberOf(heinrich, NaziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
∃x (German(x) ∧ Politician(x) ∧ MemberOf(x, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ MemberOf(x, NaziReichstag)) ::: Some German politician was part of both the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
